analysis.title: Colorful Sculptural Web3 Landing Page
analysis.notes: A dark single-page agency layout pairs oversized white and pink headlines with a vivid sculptural head assembled from colorful abstract objects. The composition uses centered hero imagery, compact metric cards, glowing interface illustrations, and strong section dividers to create a polished, high-energy presentation.
analysis.heroPrompt: A surreal 3D sculptural human head centered against a nearly black background, assembled from vivid abstract objects, translucent plastic forms, flowers, toy-like shapes, glossy geometric fragments, and saturated pink, orange, yellow, cyan, and green details. Soft magenta and amber rim lighting, subtle atmospheric glow, highly detailed mixed-material surface, editorial technology campaign aesthetic, isolated composition with generous negative space, no text, no logos, no recognizable characters.
